response.justification: Despite extensive software experience, the candidate lacks direct C++ development experience in industrial automation, secure coding per IEC 62443, or cloud-native industrial platforms — core requirements for this role. Their work centers on TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, and web technologies, with only a brief, non-detailed C++ stint at National Instruments over a decade ago, insufficient for a senior C++ architect role.
strengths: Strong full-stack and cross-platform development experience across diverse systems.
Proven track record in open-source contributions and technical education (workshops, talks).
Demonstrated ability to build scalable, event-driven systems and DevOps infrastructure.
concerns: Minimal recent or relevant C++ experience; no evidence of STL, multi-threading, or OOP in industrial contexts.
No exposure to industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443), MQTT, REST in automation, or industrial protocols (OPC UA, Modbus).
Lacks cloud platform experience (Azure) and no indication of hands-on work with IoT or on-prem industrial automation systems.
